about.intro: FTJ Exports connects collectors and enthusiasts worldwide with exceptional vehicles — sourced, inspected and shipped with uncompromising care.

values.headline: Trust, built one car at a time
values.body: Every vehicle in our showroom is personally inspected and verified before it reaches you. We believe a good deal is built on honesty, not pressure — no hidden fees, no surprises, just the right car and a straightforward process from inquiry to delivery.

passion.headline: Built for speed, driven by passion
passion.body: Our team lives and breathes performance cars. That passion shows in how we source, describe and present every vehicle — with the detail and respect each one deserves.

shipping.headline: Shipping, handled end to end
shipping.body: From first inquiry to the moment your car arrives, we manage every step — paperwork, logistics and customs — so you don't have to.

items.question: How does the inquiry process work?
items.answer: Browse our showroom and press Inquire on any vehicle that interests you. Our team will reach out directly with full details, pricing and next steps — no obligation, no pressure.

items.question: Are all vehicles inspected before listing?
items.answer: Yes. Every car in our showroom is personally inspected and verified before it is published, so what you see is exactly what you get.

items.question: Do you ship internationally, and who handles customs?
items.answer: We export worldwide and manage the full logistics chain — shipping, documentation and customs clearance — so you don't have to navigate it yourself.

items.question: Why aren't prices shown on the website?
items.answer: Every vehicle and every buyer's situation is different. Send an inquiry and our team will give you a straightforward, no-pressure quote tailored to you.

items.question: Can I request a specific car that isn't currently listed?
items.answer: Absolutely. Get in touch with what you're looking for and our sourcing team will search our network to find it for you.
